title: Revised Regulations Governing Private Schools

page_data.en:
October 24, 1933. Afternoon Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers:

REVISED REGULATIONS GOVERNING PRIVATE SCHOOLS.

On October 20, the Ministry of Education
promulgated the following revised Regulations governing
private schools:-

Chapter One: General Rule.

Art. 1. Schools established by private individuals
or bodies are private schools. This applies also to
schools established by foreigners.
Art. 2. The foundation, alteration and closure of
a private school shall be subject to sanction by the
control educational administration organ. The Ministry
of Education is the control organ of private colleges
and higher grade educational institutions. A private
middle school (including that established by a private
college or a higher grade educational institution)
takes the educational administration organ in a province
or municipality (under the direct control of the
Administrative Yuan) as a control organ. The educational
administration organ in a municipality (comprising
that under the direct control of the Administrative
Yuan) or hsien is the superior organ of private primary
schools and other similar schools. (This also applies
to private primary schools and other similar schools
established by private middle schools and higher grade
educational institutions.)
Art. 3. A private school shall be registered with
the control educational administration organ and be
subject to its supervision and direction. The organization,
course of lessons and other affairs of the school shall
be dealt with in accordance with the orders
dealing with education.
Art. 4. A private school is not allowed to establish
a branch school.
Art. 5. Unless absolutely necessary, a private college
or a higher grade educational institution shall not
establish a middle school or a primary school.
Art. 6. Foreigners are not allowed to establish in
Chinese territory primary schools for Chinese children.
Art. 7. A president of a private school shall devote
himself to his duties and shall not concurrently perform
other duties. The presidents or principals of private
middle schools or higher grade educational institutions
founded by foreigners must be Chinese.
Art. 8. Lessons on religion shall not be included
as an obligatory course for study in a private school
nor is religious propaganda allowed. If a religious
ceremony is to be held in a private school established
by a religious body, the school authorities must not
compel by force or induce students to participate
in such ceremony. No religious ceremony is to be
held in primary schools or similar schools.

《新闻报》及其他本地报纸：

修订私立学校规程。

10月20日，教育部颁布了以下修订的私立学校规程：—

第一章：总则。

第一条 由私人或团体设立的学校为私立学校。此规定亦适用于由外国人设立的学校。
第二条 私立学校的设立、变更及停办，须经主管教育行政机关核准。教育部为私立大学及高等教育机构的主管机关。私立中学（包括由私立大学或高等教育机构设立的中学）以省或院辖市的教育行政机关为主管机关。市（包括院辖市）或县的教育行政机关为私立小学及其他同类学校的上级机关。（此规定亦适用于由私立中学及高等教育机构设立的私立小学及其他同类学校。）
第三条 私立学校应向主管教育行政机关注册，并接受其监督与指导。学校的组织、课程及其他事务，应依照教育法令办理。
第四条 私立学校不得设立分校。
第五条 除非绝对必要，私立大学或高等教育机构不得设立中学或小学。
第六条 外国人不得在中国领土内为华人儿童设立小学。
第七条 私立学校校长应专任其职，不得兼任其他职务。由外国人设立的私立中学或高等教育机构的校长或负责人必须为中国人。
第八条 宗教课程不得列为私立学校的必修科目，亦不得进行宗教宣传。若由宗教团体设立的私立学校举行宗教仪式，校方不得强迫或诱导学生参加此类仪式。小学或同类学校不得举行任何宗教仪式。

Art. 9. Whenever the management of a private school is found to be not good or it acts contrary to Government mandates, the control educational administration organ may cancel its registration with the organ or order it to suspend operations. The control educational administration organ may order a private school to cease functioning and cancel the registration of its Board of Directors when it is discovered that it has been established for three years without applying for registration.
Art. 10. The nomenclature of a private school shall be such that it clearly defines the class to which it belongs. The names of provinces, municipalities, hsiens and places shall not be used for private schools. The name must be preceded by the word "private."

Chapter Two : Board of Directors.

Art. 11. The Board of Directors of a private school represents the founders. The first Board of Directors shall be organised by a certain number of persons appointed by the founders who are also Directors as a matter of course.
Art. 12. The number of persons serving on the Board of Directors of a private school shall not exceed 15 and a chairman of the Board must be appointed.
Art. 13. Regulations governing the Board of Directors of a private school shall embody stipulations concerning the organization and authority of the Board, the period of office of the Directors and the measures for the re-election of new Directors.
Art. 14. At least, one-fourth of members of the Board of Directors shall be persons who have studied education or who have dealt with educational affairs. Members of the staff of a control educational administration organ or other organs which are superior to it must not act concurrently as Directors of private schools. Foreigners may be appointed as Directors of a private school in special circumstances, but the number of foreign Directors must not exceed one-third of the total number of Directors. The chairman of the Board, however, must be a Chinese.
Art. 15. Upon its formation, the Board of Directors shall apply to the control educational administration organ for registration with the following particulars attached:-
a) Name.
b) Aim.
c) Address of the office of the Board.
d) Regulations governing the Board.
e) Funds, etc.
f) Names, ages, native places, occupations and addresses of the Directors.

第九条 凡发现私立学校管理不善或违背政府命令者，主管教育行政机关可撤销其在该机关的注册，或责令其停业。若发现私立学校成立三年未申请注册，主管教育行政机关可责令其停止运作，并撤销其董事会的注册。
第十条 私立学校的名称应能明确界定其所属类别。私立学校不得使用省、市、县及地名的名称。校名前必须冠以“私立”二字。

第二章：董事会。

第十一条 私立学校董事会代表创办人。首届董事会由创办人指派的若干人员组成，该等人员自然成为董事。
第十二条 私立学校董事会成员人数不得超过15人，并须推选董事长一人。
第十三条 私立学校董事会章程应包含关于董事会的组织与职权、董事任期以及新董事改选措施的规定。
第十四条 董事会成员中，至少四分之一应为曾修习教育或从事教育事务的人员。主管教育行政机关或其上级机关的职员不得兼任私立学校董事。在特殊情况下，外国人可被任命为私立学校董事，但外籍董事人数不得超过董事总数的三分之一。然而，董事长必须为中国人。
第十五条 董事会成立后，应向主管教育行政机关申请注册，并附具下列详情：—
a) 名称。
b) 宗旨。
c) 董事会办公地址。
d) 董事会章程。
e) 资金等。
f) 董事的姓名、年龄、籍贯、职业及地址。

Art. 19 - The duties of the Board of Directors,
except in cases in which sanction has been given by the
educational administration organ, are as follows:-
1. Responsibilities of the Board of Directors regarding
monetary matters.
a. Plans to raise funds.
b. Examination of budget and expenses of the past
year.
c. Custody of funds.
d. Supervision over monetary matters.
e. Other monetary matters.
2. The principal or president elected by the Board of
Directors is responsible for the school administration, and
no direct participation in it by the Board is permitted.
The school master or principal thus elected should be approved
by the authorities of the educational administration. In
cases of neglect of duty by the school master or principal,
the Board of Directors can elect another one at any time
to replace him. Should the newly elected principal also
fail in his duty, the school master or principal should be
appointed by the educational administration organ for the
time being . Should any trouble arise in the Board of
Directors and a deadlock is reached, the educational admi-
nistration organ can order a reorganization of the board
within a given period. If necessary, the Board may be
organized by the administration organ. The Principal of
the middle school of a private college or of the primary
school of a private middle school, or of a school of the
same standard, should be elected by the Board of Directors.
Art. 20- The Board of Directors should, within one
month of the end of a school term, submit a report on the
following items to the educational administration organ:-
1. Progress of school.
2. Important work performed during the previous year.
3. Receipts and disbursements of the previous year.
4. List of school faculty and students.
Art. 21 - An examination must be made once a year
by the educational administration organ into the monetary
and other matters handled by the Board of Directors. If
necessary, the examination can be held at any time.
Art. 22 - In case a private school ceases to operate,
a petition should be submitted to the educational admini-
stration organ by the Board of Directors within 10 days
of the closing of the school for the liquidation of the
affairs of the school. After the liquidation, a report
is to be submitted by the liquidator to the educational
administration organ for record purposes.
Art. 23 - Private schools and their property can not
be taken over by the educational administration organ, but
when the school ceases to operate and consequently the
Board of Directors loses its status, the property of the
school can be disposed of by the educational administration
organ.
Art. 24 - In case of trouble arising from the monetary
matters of the Board of Directors, the law court should
be asked to settle it.

第十九条 除经教育行政机关核准的情况外，董事会的职责如下：—
1. 董事会在财务方面的职责。
a. 筹款计划。
b. 审查上年度预算及支出。
c. 资金保管。
d. 财务监督。
e. 其他财务事项。
2. 由董事会选举的校长或负责人负责学校行政，董事会不得直接参与。经选举产生的校长或负责人须经教育行政机关批准。若校长或负责人失职，董事会可随时选举另一人接替。若新当选的校长亦未能履行职责，则由教育行政机关暂时委派校长或负责人。若董事会内部发生纠纷且陷入僵局，教育行政机关可责令其在限期内重组董事会。如有必要，可由教育行政机关组织董事会。私立大学的附属中学校长、私立中学的附属小学校长或同等标准学校的校长，应由董事会选举产生。
第二十条 董事会应在每学期结束后的一个月内，向教育行政机关提交下列项目的报告：—
1. 学校进展。
2. 上一年度完成的重要工作。
3. 上一年度的收支情况。
4. 教职员工及学生名单。
第二十一条 教育行政机关每年须对董事会处理的财务及其他事项进行一次检查。如有必要，可随时进行检查。
第二十二条 若私立学校停止办学，董事会应在学校关闭后10天内向教育行政机关提交申请，以清算学校事务。清算结束后，清算人应向教育行政机关提交报告备案。
第二十三条 教育行政机关不得接管私立学校及其财产，但当学校停止办学导致董事会丧失地位时，学校财产可由教育行政机关处置。
第二十四条 若因董事会财务事项引发纠纷，应提请法院裁决。

（待续。）

第四章

私立中学、小学及其他同类学校

第三十条：凡设立私立中学、小学或同等程度之学校者，应遵守下列规定：-
(1) 须待董事会向教育机关注册后，方可提出申请。未经上级教育行政机关核准立案，不得刊登招生广告。申请注册时，应随附校舍照片及说明，并列明下列详情：-
(a) 学校名称（如有外文名称，须一并注明。）
(b) 校址。
(c) 校地及校舍状况。
(d) 经费来源及开办费与其他费用之初步预算。
(e) 组织系统及课程。
(f) 教科书及参考书清单。
(g) 仪器、家具、体育及卫生用品之库存及其价值。
(h) 校长及教师资历说明。
(2) 学校成立满一年后，应申请注册。申请书中应提及下列事项：-
(a) 开学以来之学校状况。
(b) 前条(d)及(h)项所述事项。
(c) 各项学校规章及细则。
(d) 学生姓名。

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers:

REVISED REGULATIONS GOVERNING PRIVATE SCHOOLS.

On October 20, the Ministry of Education
promulgated the following revised Regulations governing
private schools:-

Chapter One: General Rule.

Art. 1. Schools established by private individuals
or bodies are private schools. This applies also to
schools established by foreigners.
Art. 2. The foundation, alteration and closure of
a private school shall be subject to sanction by the
control educational administration organ. The Ministry
of Education is the control organ of private colleges
and higher grade educational institutions. A private
middle school (including that established by a private
college or a higher grade educational institution)
takes the educational administration organ in a province
or municipality (under the direct control of the
Administrative Yuan) as a control organ. The educational
administration organ in a municipality (comprising
that under the direct control of the Administrative
Yuan) or hsien is the superior organ of private primary
schools and other similar schools. (This also applies
to private primary schools and other similar schools
established by private middle schools and higher grade
educational institutions.)
Art. 3. A private school shall be registered with
the control educational administration organ and be
subject to its supervision and direction. The organization,
course of lessons and other affairs of the school shall
be dealt with in accordance with orders
dealing with education.
Art. 4. A private school is not allowed to establish
a branch school.
Art. 5. Unless absolutely necessary, a private college
or a higher grade educational institution shall not
establish a middle school or a primary school.
Art. 6. Foreigners are not allowed to establish in
Chinese territory primary schools for Chinese children.
Art. 7. A president of a private school shall devote
himself to his duties and shall not concurrently perform
other duties. The presidents or principals of private
middle schools or higher grade educational institutions
founded by foreigners must be Chinese.
Art. 8. Lessons on religion shall not be included
as an obligatory course for study in a private school
nor is religious propaganda allowed. If a religious
ceremony is to be held in a private school established
by a religious body, the school authorities must not
compel by force or induce students to participate
in such ceremony. No religious ceremony is to be
held in primary schools or similar schools.

修订私立学校规程。

10 月 20 日，教育部颁布了以下修订后的私立学校规程：—

第一章：总则。

第一条 由私人或团体设立的学校为私立学校。此规定亦适用于由外国人设立的学校。
第二条 私立学校的设立、变更及停办，须经主管教育行政机关核准。教育部为私立大学及高等教育机构的主管机关。私立中学（包括由私立大学或高等教育机构设立的中学）以省或院辖市的教育行政机关为主管机关。院辖市或县的教育行政机关为私立小学及其他同类学校的上级机关。（此规定亦适用于由私立中学及高等教育机构设立的私立小学及其他同类学校。）
第三条 私立学校应向主管教育行政机关注册，并接受其监督与指导。学校的组织、课程及其他事务，应依照有关教育的法令办理。
第四条 私立学校不得设立分校。
第五条 除非绝对必要，私立大学或高等教育机构不得设立中学或小学。
第六条 外国人不得在中国领土内为华人儿童设立小学。
第七条 私立学校校长应专任其职，不得兼任其他职务。由外国人创办的私立中学或高等教育机构的校长或院长必须为中国人。
第八条 宗教课程不得列为私立学校的必修科目，亦不得进行宗教宣传。若由宗教团体设立的私立学校举行宗教仪式，校方不得强迫或诱导学生参加此类仪式。小学或同类学校不得举行任何宗教仪式。

Art. 11. The Board of Directors of a private school represents the founders. The first Board of Directors shall be organised by a certain number of persons appointed by the founders who are also Directors as a matter of course.
Art. 12. The number of persons serving on the Board of Directors of a private school shall not exceed 15 and a chairman of the Board must be appointed.
Art. 13. Regulations governing the Board of Directors of a private school shall embody stipulations concerning the organization and authority of the Board, the period of office of the Directors and the measures for the re-election of new Directors.
Art. 14. At least, one-fourth of the members of the Board of Directors shall be persons who have studied education or who have dealt with educational affairs. Members of the staff of a control educational administration organ or other organs which are superior to it must not act concurrently as Directors of private schools. Foreigners may be appointed as Directors of a private school in special circumstances, but the number of foreign Directors must not exceed one-third of the total number of Directors. The chairman of the Board, however, must be a Chinese.

a) Name.
b) Aim.
c) Address of the office of the Board.
d) Regulations governing the Board.
e) Funds, etc.
f) Names, ages, native places, occupations and addresses of the Directors.

第九条 凡发现私立学校管理不善或其行为违背政府命令时，主管教育行政机关可撤销其在机关的注册，或责令其停业。若发现私立学校成立三年而未申请注册，主管教育行政机关可责令其停止运作，并撤销其董事会的注册。
第十条 私立学校的名称应能明确界定其所属类别。私立学校不得使用省、市、县及地名的名称。名称前必须冠以“私立”二字。

第二章：董事会。

第十一条 私立学校董事会代表创办人。首届董事会应由创办人指派的若干人员组成，该等人员自然成为董事。
第十二条 私立学校董事会人数不得超过十五人，并须推选董事长一人。
第十三条 私立学校董事会章程应包含关于董事会的组织与职权、董事任期以及新董事改选措施的规定。
第十四条 董事会成员中，至少四分之一应为曾修习教育或从事教育事务的人员。主管教育行政机关或其他上级机关的职员，不得兼任私立学校董事。在特殊情况下，外国人可被任命为私立学校董事，但外籍董事人数不得超过董事总数的三分之一。然而，董事长必须为中国人。
第十五条 董事会成立后，应向主管教育行政机关申请注册，并附具下列详情：—
a) 名称。
b) 宗旨。
c) 董事会办公地址。
d) 董事会章程。
e) 资金等。
f) 董事的姓名、年龄、籍贯、职业及地址。
